description: The figure is a concentric (two-ring) donut pie chart intended to show “Win rate (%)” comparisons of GPT‑4o against two base models, with the win-rate values labeled on the chart. The outer ring contains 2 slices: a large blue-gray slice labeled “GPT‑4o: 96.8%” and a small light-blue slice labeled “LLaMA: 3.2%.” The inner ring also contains 2 slices: a large dark maroon slice labeled “GPT‑4o: 98.4%” and a very thin near-white slice labeled “Mistral: 1.2%.” The center of the donut contains the text “Win rate (%)”; there is no separate legend, and the percentages are presented as external text labels connected to slices with leader lines rather than printed inside the segments. No slice appears exploded or offset, and in both rings the GPT‑4o segment visually dominates with the opposing model shown as a narrow remainder segment.
